newsitem.title: USA: SL Industries sees after-tax gain on unit's sale.
newsitem.headline: SL Industries sees after-tax gain on unit's sale.

text.p: SL Industries Inc said Wednesday it expects to record a substantial after-tax gain on the sale of its unit, SL Auburn Inc, to Cooper Industries Inc on May 1.
It said it received received $12.029 million in cash in the sale, which included substantially all assets of SL Auburn, but excluding real property.
The purchase price is subject to adjustment, depending upon the value of the net assets of SL Auburn at the closing date, the final amount of which has not yet been determined, it said.
The company said the gain, which a company official declined to estimate, will be reflected in SL Industries' consolidated financial statements for the third quarter ended April 30.
SL Industries designs, manufactures and markets power and data equipment and systems for industrial, medical, aerospace and consumer applications.
